class.name: OpenXRFbSpatialEntityBatch
class.brief_description: Used to batch save or share spatial entities.
class.description: Used to batch save or share a collection of [OpenXRFbSpatialEntity]s in a single operation.

method.name: save_to_storage
method.description: Saves all the spatial entities in this batch to the given storage location as a single operation. This is an asynchronous operation - the [signal openxr_fb_spatial_entity_batch_saved] signal will be emitted when completed with an argument indicating if it was successful or not.

method.name: share_with_users
method.description: Shares all the spatial entities in this batch with the given users in a single operation. This is an asynchronous operation - the [signal openxr_fb_spatial_entity_batch_shared] signal will be emitted when completed with an argument indicating if it was successful or not.

method.name: share_with_groups
method.description: Shares all the spatial entities in this batch with the given application-defined group UUID strings in a single operation. You can check runtime support ahead of time with [method OpenXRMetaSpatialEntitySharingExtension.is_spatial_entity_group_sharing_supported]. This is an asynchronous operation - the [signal openxr_fb_spatial_entity_batch_shared] signal will be emitted when completed with an argument indicating if it was successful or not.

members.member: The spatial entities in this batch.

signal.name: openxr_fb_spatial_entity_batch_saved
signal.description: Emitted when the save operation has completed. See [method save_to_storage].

signal.name: openxr_fb_spatial_entity_batch_shared
signal.description: Emitted when the share operation has completed. See [method share_with_users] and [method share_with_groups].
